name: featured-icon
title: Featured Icon
description: An icon set in a tinted rounded square or circle, with a soft outer ring: the mark at the head of a feature card, a step, or a section. It gives a row of features one shared shape, so the icons read as a set rather than as loose glyphs of different weights.
author: ofri-peretz <https://github.com/ofri-peretz>
docs:
## @interlace/featured-icon

Installed to `components/ui/featured-icon.tsx`.

```tsx
import { /* … */ } from '@/components/ui/featured-icon';
```

Props, a11y contract, live preview and source: https://ds.interlace.tools/c/featured-icon

Requires the `@interlace/interlace-base` CSS baseline (installed automatically as a registry dependency). For the Interlace look, also add `@interlace/theme`.
